title: Anchor links (e.g. /ds#2-reversing-linked-list) do not scroll
description: TOC links point to #page-slug but no element carried those ids in SSR HTML, so native and router hash nav both fail. Fix: id on section wrappers + valid Nuxt3 scrollBehavior.
